notes: Frame: the camp seat's own (x across, z along, y up), as the kit's; the habitat stands in the middle, its own place, turned and lifted by its seat.

The ending: the camp follows K05's (captain, 2026-10-12): Bram under the cairn beside the tall boulder. The cairn stands as a plan object waiting on its model (the prop route's next batch). The drift and sample case out in the dust and the cast (Bram lying, Oona beside him) belong to the other ending; the people and cast tracks follow K05 too, and Oona's facing stays open until the casts land.
